texts.value: Involved in photosynthetic carbon assimilation. Catalyzes the NAD(P)-dependent oxidative phosphorylation of glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) to 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate (BPG). The first reaction step involves the formation of a hemiacetal intermediate between G3P and a cysteine residue, and this hemiacetal intermediate is then oxidized to a thioester, with concomitant reduction of NAD to NADH. The reduced NADH is then exchanged with the second NAD, and the thioester is attacked by a nucleophilic inorganic phosphate to produce BPG. It can use both NADP and NAD

bridge.primary_construct: Supplementary FigureS2 panelA, cp12-WT synthetic complementation insert in pVZ322
bridge.source_locator: DataSheet_1.pdf printed page4, FigureS2A red coding sequence; caption; main s2_1/p1
bridge.identity_method: Visual transcription of all red coding codons from original PDF image, independent standard-code translation, exact entire74aa comparison with retained issuing UniProt body. Shown amino-acid rows also visually concordant.
bridge.current_entry_tier: Unreviewed; no function comment; CP12 domain is ECO0000259 SMART annotation. Experimental inference comes from sequence-matched primary construct, not automated domain label.
bridge.scope_limit: The sequence-matched synthetic WT complementation protein was tested in GT PCC6803. The culture is not identified as Kazusa, and no independent full native GT-genome cp12 sequence is provided.

supplement_scope.TableS1: Printed page2 still gives glucose-tolerant PCC6803 WT without a named GT substrain; cp12 deletion/WT rescue/Cys variants and tagged genes are listed.
supplement_scope.TableS2: Printed page2 supplies cp12-specific and flanking primers; not complete native-genome sequencing.
supplement_scope.FigureS2: WT and Cys19/29/60/69-to-Ser constructs are shown. Only WT coding sequence is independently transcribed in this contribution; variant sites were visually inspected.
supplement_scope.FigureS1: Schematic background model, not new direct measurement of physical binding, thioredoxin reduction, or exact complex stoichiometry.
supplement_scope.FiguresS4/S5: Captioned genotyping supports full deletion segregation and incomplete GapDH2-eYFP segregation; no band quantitation undertaken here.

recommended_edge.subject: UniProtKB:P73654
recommended_edge.evidence_level: Qualified system-level genetic/physiological inference, with exact rescue-protein sequence bridge. It is not purified enzyme inhibition or a measured reaction flux.
recommended_edge.source_assertion: WT CP12 (Fig. S2A; 74-aa sequence equal to P73654) restores glucose growth and WT-like NAD(P)H kinetics in delta-cp12 GT PCC6803. CP12-dependent PRK/GapDH2 foci and metabolite phenotypes support conditional CBB regulation; direct enzyme inhibition was not measured.
recommended_edge.source_locator: Supplement p4 Fig.S2A; main s2_1/p1, s3_1/p1-p3, s3_2/p2,p4-p5, s3_4/p1-p2
recommended_edge.qualification: If the author cannot preserve the system-level and condition qualifications, keep these results as prose context instead of a stronger edge.

main_source_scope_ledger.result: Native CP12 complementation rescues glucose-sensitive growth under diurnal/dark conditions.
main_source_scope_ledger.safe_scope: Conditional genotype-to-phenotype effect; Cys variant docking assignments rely on cited work.
